column1: # Skips a package's own test code always takes, whatever the machine: a block
# GNU R records as skipped for one of these reasons leaves the denominator of
# the 80% green floor (docs/verification.md). It is still a block, and robigo
# must still skip it the same way. Kept by hand, one reason per line, each
# under a comment citing the line of the package's source that makes it
# unconditional. Environment skips (skip_on_ci, missing Suggests, hosts of the
# internet) never go here: the floor exists for them. An entry applies to its
# version only, so a new snapshot has to check it again.
# tests/testthat/helper.R:1: skip_httpbin <- function() skip("httpbin is not reliable"),
# at 20 call sites in test-body, test-config, test-content, test-http-error,
# test-http-head, test-oauth and test-response, none of them under a condition
